answer.rationale: Regional failover is the optimal single intervention for a primary-region-confined write path degradation when rollback is prohibited by compliance. Memory_b2 proves this approach can restore latency and recover error rates within minutes via clean traffic shifting. Rollback (memory_b1) is invalidated by the mandatory security patch. Other options fail to address the core issue: circuit breakers (memory_b4) target dependency outages, not latency; capacity addition (memory_b3) is likely too slow at peak load; read replica routing (memory_b5) only offloads reads. Regional failover directly mitigates the regional bottleneck while preserving all customer writes.
